text: PrefixEncoder (libsufr/src/build.rs) ranks a byte outside its table as 0, the sentinel's rank, so such a byte would share a bucket with the sentinel and break the order across partitions. from_occupancy picks the narrowest table that covers every byte normalize saw, which prevents that; a user-declared alphabet could not do the same job without validation. The width follows the count of distinct bytes, so a stray byte can halve the key (sufr-aa4802).
